 2026 DIII football championship: Bracket, schedule, scores
 DIII football: 2026 selection show 
 Share 
 The full 40-team championship field for the single-elimination tournament was revealed during a selection show on Sunday, Nov. 15, live-streamed here on NCAA.com. For selections, 28 teams earn automatic bids, with the remaining spots filled by at-large bids.  Click or tap here for the press release.
 Here’s everything you need to know for the 2026 NCAA DIII football championship.
 2026 DIII football championship bracket:
 Click or tap here for the 2026 interactive bracket .
 2026 DIII football championship schedule:
 First round: Saturday, Nov. 21
 12 p.m. | Amherst vs. Bridgewater State 
 12 p.m. | Susquehanna vs. Eastern 
 12 p.m. | Trinity (Connecticut) vs. Rensselaer 
 1 p.m. | Benedictine (Illinois) vs. Hanover 
 1 p.m. | Hardin-Simmons vs. Texas Lutheran 
 1 p.m. | Heidelberg vs. Monmouth (Illinois) 
 1:30 p.m. | Wartburg vs. Northwestern-State Paul 
 3 p.m. | CMS vs. Huntingdon 
 Second round: Saturday, Nov. 28
 Third Round: Saturday, Dec. 5
 Quarterfinals: Saturday, Dec. 12 
 Semifinals : Saturday, Dec. 19
 Finals: Sunday, Jan. 3
 Selection show: 5 p.m. ET on Sunday, Nov. 15 on NCAA.com
